newsitem.title: FRANCE: Accor no comment on Bass bid talk.
newsitem.headline: Accor no comment on Bass bid talk.

text.p: French hotels group Accor declined to comment on Thursday on stock market rumours that British brewing and leisure company Bass Plc was planning to bid for Accor.
"We have no comment to make," a spokeswoman for Accor told Reuters.
A spokeswoman for Bass earlier also declined to comment.
Accor shares were up 2.98 percent at 726 francs at 1153 GMT while Bass shares were down 4-1/2 pence in London.

Dealers in Paris said they thought the rumour might have been started by speculation in the French press, sparked by Hilton Hotels' takeover offer for ITT Corp on Monday, that Accor would be a good takeover target.
